title: A rule nothing checks is a reminder
statement: Record each content rule's scope and what checks it, because a rule nothing checks is only a reminder.
detail: The reading workspace's laws file pairs each law with a check that the pre-commit hook runs, and says a law without a check is not a law but a memory. A plan to centralise the reading standards binds each rule to one or more evidence lanes: deterministic code, a model judge that is advisory until calibrated, the live student or runtime surface, and expert human review. A rule-by-rule audit found rules whose enforcement notes scoped them far narrower than they read, and recommended a consistent scope line on each.

evidence.quote: A law without a check is not a law here — it is a memory.
